Smile care

A conversation first.
A choice that feels yours.

Start by describing what you would like to change about your smile. A consultation gives you room to discuss options, existing dental work, oral health and the results that may be realistic.

Whitening and other cosmetic treatments are not suitable for everyone. Ask your dentist to explain suitability, alternatives, sensitivity, ongoing care and costs before deciding.

Plan a visit
What to expect

A clear path through your visit.

  1. 01Tell us your goals.

    Bring the questions and details that would help explain what matters most to you.

  2. 02Explore suitable options.

    Discuss your oral health, the available approaches and what each one can and cannot do.

  3. 03Take time to decide.

    Review the proposed plan, costs, aftercare and alternatives before choosing your next step.

Make room for your questions

Ask the things
that matter to you.

You deserve to understand the recommendation before choosing what happens next. These questions can help start the conversation.

  • Which options are suitable for my teeth?
  • How could existing dental work affect the result?
  • What are the limitations and ongoing care needs?
A few helpful answers

Before your visit.

A little preparation can make the next conversation feel easier.

All your questions, answered
Can every tooth be whitened?

Whitening does not work in the same way on all discolouration, and restorations such as crowns and fillings do not whiten like natural teeth. Ask your dentist what this means for your smile.

Can I discuss options without deciding immediately?

Yes. Ask for explanations of the options, limitations, costs and care involved so you can make an informed decision in your own time.

Is the comparison image a real treatment result?

No. The website’s smile comparison is an illustration for the design. It does not predict an individual result or represent a documented patient case.
